'''Glid Station''' was a military outpost established by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].

==History==
[[File:Glid_Station.png|thumb|left|200px|The interior of the Glid Station hangar]]

Early in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Pantoran Assembly/Legends|Pantoran Assembly]] of the [[Pantora/Legends|Pantora]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] asked the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to establish an outpost on the nearby [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Orto Plutonia to serve as an advanced warning station for any [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] incursions. To that end, the Republic established Glid Station, a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] outpost built within a massive ice spire. But the Separatists too had established a temporary base on the surface, and all this activity aggravated the planet's native [[Talz/Legends|Talz]]. They attacked the newcomers, wiping out both the Republic and Separatist outposts and leaving no survivors.

The Republic sent a task force to investigate, led by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], assisted by a squad of [[Clone cold assault trooper/Legends|clone cold assault troopers]]. The [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] side was represented by the [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[Chi Cho/Legends|Chi Cho]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Riyo Chuchi/Legends|Riyo Chuchi]]. Upon entering the Glid Station Cho believed that the Separatists had attacked the outpost, but the Jedi have investigated the disappearance of their troopers and discovered the village of the native [[Talz/Legends|Talz]]. The Republic forces continued to use Glid Station as their base for a short time, but after the [[Battle of Orto Plutonia/Legends|Battle of Orto Plutonia]], Senator [[Riyo Chuchi/Legends|Riyo Chuchi]], backed by the [[Pantoran Assembly/Legends|Pantoran Assembly]], ceded ownership of [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]] to the Talz, allowing them sovereignty over the planet. She withdrew both the Republic and Pantoran presence from the world, leaving the Talz free to live their lives, and the Glid Station was abandoned.
